eval_instructions: When running these evals, test against real .NET AgentFramework and Node.js LangChain agent projects. The agent must not modify any source files — all actions are read-only against the codebase.

evals.description: Happy path — .NET AgentFramework agent, agentsplayground already installed, user confirms launch
evals.expected_output: The skill detects .NET AgentFramework, confirms agentsplayground is installed, runs dotnet build successfully, asks the user whether to launch, starts dotnet run in the background, launches agentsplayground -e http://localhost:5000/api/messages -c emulator, and guides the local test.
expectations: Phase 1: Agent type detected as .NET AgentFramework
Phase 1: Default port set to 5000
Phase 2: agentsplayground --version is run to check installation
Phase 2: agentsplayground is confirmed installed — no install attempted
Phase 3: dotnet build is run and succeeds
Phase 4: User is asked whether to start agent and open playground
Phase 4: dotnet run is started in background after user confirms
Phase 4: agentsplayground -e http://localhost:5000/api/messages -c emulator is launched
Phase 5: User is told to watch terminal for Microsoft.Agents.A365.Observability log lines
Phase 5: User is told to set EnableAgent365Exporter: true to export to A365 service
Phase 6: Final summary shows agent endpoint and emulator mode note
No source files are modified

evals.description: Happy path — Node.js LangChain agent, agentsplayground already installed, user confirms launch
evals.expected_output: The skill detects Node.js LangChain, confirms agentsplayground is installed, runs npm install successfully, asks the user whether to launch, starts npm start in the background, launches agentsplayground -e http://localhost:3978/api/messages -c emulator, and guides the local test.
expectations: Phase 1: Agent type detected as Node.js LangChain
Phase 1: Default port set to 3978
Phase 2: agentsplayground --version is run to check installation
Phase 2: agentsplayground is confirmed installed — no install attempted
Phase 3: npm install is run and succeeds
Phase 4: User is asked whether to start agent and open playground
Phase 4: npm start is started in background after user confirms
Phase 4: agentsplayground -e http://localhost:3978/api/messages -c emulator is launched
Phase 5: User is told to watch terminal for observability log lines
Phase 5: User is told to set ENABLE_A365_OBSERVABILITY_EXPORTER=true to export
Phase 6: Final summary shows agent endpoint and emulator mode note
No source files are modified

evals.description: agentsplayground not installed — skill installs it automatically
evals.expected_output: The skill detects the agent type, finds agentsplayground is missing, runs npm install -g @microsoft/agentsplayground, confirms it installed, then continues the normal launch flow.
expectations: Phase 2: agentsplayground --version returns nothing — not installed
Phase 2: npm install -g @microsoft/agentsplayground is run
Phase 2: agentsplayground --version is re-run to confirm successful install
Skill continues to Phase 3 after successful install
No source files are modified

evals.description: User declines to launch — skill shows manual commands and exits cleanly
evals.expected_output: The skill completes detection, install check, and build, then asks the user whether to launch. When the user says no, the skill shows the two terminal commands and exits without starting any processes.
expectations: Phase 1: Agent type detected
Phase 2: agentsplayground confirmed or installed
Phase 3: Build passes
Phase 4: User is asked whether to launch — user says no
Phase 4: Manual commands are shown (start command + agentsplayground command)
Phase 4: No background process is started
Phase 6: Final summary shown
No source files are modified

evals.description: Build fails — skill stops before attempting launch
evals.expected_output: The skill detects the agent type, confirms agentsplayground is installed, attempts to build, encounters build errors, presents the error output to the user, and stops without launching anything.
expectations: Phase 1: Agent type detected
Phase 2: agentsplayground confirmed installed
Phase 3: Build command is run and fails
Phase 3: Error output is shown to user
Phase 3: Skill stops — does not proceed to Phase 4
No background processes are started
No source files are modified
